name: Super Fun: Football
summary: Super Fun: Football is an arcade football game with online and local multiplayer, offering co-operative and versus matches. Players can choose 4v4, 5v5 or 6v6 formats and combine human and CPU players on either team. Matches feature headers, curling shots, bicycle kicks, tackles that can hit teammates, and slow-motion goal replays. Pitch events include sprinklers, a passing cyclist and a dog chasing the ball.
